inputs.value: A full-body portrait of an elite ghost agent woman with long blonde hair in a high ponytail, fair skin, and focused expression. She wears a form-fitting futuristic combat bodysuit of smooth white and light gray material with deliberate skin exposure on the bare arms, open midriff waist, and upper thighs. Dark high-energy tech armor plating covers the shoulders, wraps around the lower torso below the chest, the outer thighs, and the sides of the hips, along with the boots, featuring glowing cyan blue energy lines precisely along the shoulder pauldrons, forearm sections, and calf armor. A pair of sleek black tactical agent glasses rests perched on the top of her head, each lens centered with a circular aperture that emits a soft blue glow. She stands confidently holding a massive futuristic sniper rifle at her side. The background is a clean minimalist spaceship cabin interior with smooth gray-white walls and soft neutral lighting that keeps the focus on the subject, cinematic 3D game character style with sharp details and cool blue accents.
